units.title: Hello — who I am
units.canDo: I can greet someone, say who I am, where I'm from and what I do, and ask them the same.

units.title: My day-to-day
units.canDo: I can say where I live and work, what I do on a normal day and how I am, and ask simple questions.

units.title: Likes, wants and plans
units.canDo: I can say what I like, want and can do, and what I'm going to do this weekend.

units.title: The weekend
units.canDo: I can say what I did yesterday and last weekend, in order.

units.title: People in my life
units.canDo: I can describe my family and friends: who they are, what they look like, what they're like and how old they are.

units.title: How it was
units.canDo: I can describe what a place or a person was like and say what happened there and how long ago.

units.title: Where I live
units.canDo: I can say what there is in my home and neighbourhood, where things are, and how much of everything there is.

units.title: Have you ever…?
units.canDo: I can talk about places I've been and things I've done or haven't done yet, and say what I can and know how to do.

units.title: My routine
units.canDo: I can describe my whole day, say what I'm doing right now and what I have to do.

units.title: Food and ordering
units.canDo: I can order food and drink, say what I and other people like, and ask for what's missing.

units.title: How life used to be
units.canDo: I can describe what my life used to be like and compare it with now.

units.title: Telling a story
units.canDo: I can tell a short story: what happened, what it was like, and what was going on when it happened.

units.title: Around the city
units.canDo: I can ask for and give directions, use public transport, and tell a friend or a stranger what to do.

units.title: Joining it up
units.canDo: I can write a connected message with reasons and details instead of short separate sentences.

units.title: How are you feeling?
units.canDo: I can say how I and others feel, physically and emotionally, and say what I think of things.

units.title: Shopping
units.canDo: I can shop for clothes and other things: ask, compare, try on, pay and return something.

units.title: Making plans
units.canDo: I can make, accept and turn down plans, and talk about conditions and timing.

units.title: On the road
units.canDo: I can travel by bus or plane, book a room, and sort out tickets, luggage and directions.

units.title: Work and studies
units.canDo: I can talk about my job and studies, read a job ad, and say what a workplace needs.

units.title: Guesses and predictions
units.canDo: I can guess what's going on, make predictions and promises, and give advice with "would" and "should".

units.title: What I want you to do
units.canDo: I can ask someone to do something, say what I need from them, and tell them not to do something.

units.title: Good news, bad news
units.canDo: I can congratulate, wish someone well, react to good and bad news, and send a warm message.

units.title: Sorting things out
units.canDo: I can deal with a bank, a phone company or a repair: explain the problem, how long it's lasted, and what I need.

units.title: Reasons and choices
units.canDo: I can explain a decision, weigh reasons for and against, and correct what someone assumed.

units.title: Places and people in detail
units.canDo: I can describe a place and a person in detail and pass on what someone told me.

units.title: Telling it well
units.canDo: I can tell an anecdote in a clear order, say how it happened, and react to someone else's.

units.title: Writing it down
units.canDo: I can write a short email, review or message at paragraph length, with a purpose and reactions.

units.title: What I think
units.canDo: I can give and ask for opinions, judge situations, and say what I don't think.

units.title: Agreeing and arguing
units.canDo: I can agree, disagree, doubt and concede without turning it into a fight.

units.title: Feelings
units.canDo: I can say how other people's actions make me feel, and describe how people change.

units.title: A longer story
units.canDo: I can tell a story that reaches back before its own beginning, and report what people said.

units.title: Advice and plans
units.canDo: I can give advice at different levels of directness and talk about plans that depend on when things happen.

units.title: Looking for something
units.canDo: I can describe exactly what I'm looking for, even when I don't know if it exists.

units.title: Mishaps
units.canDo: I can explain an accident or a mishap, what got lost or broken, and ask for help.

units.title: At the doctor
units.canDo: I can explain symptoms, understand advice and instructions, and talk about rules.

units.title: Work and money
units.canDo: I can talk about money, prices and results, compare figures and draw conclusions.

units.title: Keeping a conversation going
units.canDo: I can keep a conversation going: show interest, interrupt, check I understood and pass on messages.

units.title: In the news
units.canDo: I can follow a news story, say what happened and why, and react to it.

units.title: Joining ideas
units.canDo: I can write a connected text with an introduction, a development and a conclusion.

units.title: If things were different
units.canDo: I can talk about imaginary situations and say what I would do.

units.title: Wishes and regrets
units.canDo: I can say what I wish were different and report what people asked me to do.

units.title: One thing, five ways
units.canDo: I can make the same request at five levels of formality and know which one fits.

units.title: What would have happened
units.canDo: I can talk about what would have happened if things had gone differently, and hedge about what probably did.

units.title: Making the case
units.canDo: I can argue a position with evidence, conditions and concessions.

units.title: The news
units.canDo: I can follow and write a news report, including what is only alleged.

units.title: Who said what
units.canDo: I can report a whole conversation accurately, and distance myself from what was said.

units.title: Putting the weight where you want it
units.canDo: I can move the emphasis in a sentence so my point lands where I want it.

units.title: Describing precisely
units.canDo: I can describe objects, places and processes precisely in writing.

units.title: Formal writing
units.canDo: I can write a formal letter: an application, a complaint and a request.

units.title: Hard conversations
units.canDo: I can handle a conversation where we want different things, and keep it civil.

units.title: Spanish beyond Colombia
units.canDo: I can read Spanish from Spain and other countries, and understand vosotros and Spain's use of the past.

units.title: The whole verb system
units.canDo: I can choose any tense or mood deliberately and explain why I chose it.

units.title: Saying it without owning it
units.canDo: I can report claims, rumours and other people's ideas without vouching for them.

units.title: Irony and what's left unsaid
units.canDo: I can use and catch irony, understatement and implied meaning.

units.title: Institutional Spanish
units.canDo: I can read and write institutional and legal Spanish without sounding like a form.

units.title: The essay
units.canDo: I can write a sustained argumentative essay and defend it.

units.title: Emotion at native pitch
units.canDo: I can express complex emotions precisely: regret, resignation, relief, mixed feelings.

units.title: Precision
units.canDo: I can describe the physical and temporal world with native precision.

units.title: Voices of Colombia
units.canDo: I can understand regional Colombian voices and adapt my own register to who I'm talking to.

units.title: A critical voice
units.canDo: I can write and defend a critical review in my own voice.
